title: Handmade Ceramic Coffee Mug
category: Home & Living < Kitchen & Dining < Drink & Barware < Drinkware < Mugs
description: This is another glaze variation of my most-comfortable-in-your-hand coffee or hot tea mug. Holds about 14-16 ounces, is dishwasher safe and is glazed blue on the inside and top rim. White is the glaze on the bottom half and the cross over is a milky light blue. A favorite of my dear friend @sarahkay_3 who convinced me to bring this glaze combo back! Microwave face, food safe. Each mug varies slightly in size but are approximately 4 inches tall, the base is just over 2 inches and the top opening is just over 3 1/2 inches.

reviews.text: I absolutely love this beautiful mug! Quick shipping, thanks so much!
It’s the perfect coffee cup I’ve been looking for for 5 years
